response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_country_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins, ca.average_wins - am.mean_wins AS excess_over_all FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS am WHERE ca.average_wins > am.mean_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_average) SELECT AVG(aa.average_wins) AS mean_average_wins, AVG(aa.excess_over_all) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(aa.average_wins - aam.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_average FROM above_average AS aa CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam WHERE aa.average_wins > aam.mean_wins
